findings.text: The populated field read of E101154 was not achieved: GetEqData(0,101154,t) returned IRET=300 for every slice read (500..11500 ms), so GetEqItem returned empty arrays and the field shapes, dtypes and units in section -fields are the reader's declared schema, not an E101154 measurement. The fragment states this plainly at section -iret, so it is a follow-on rather than a blocking gap: the eqdb-reader question is about the entry and the record's field set, both of which are answered.

The claim that the 129x129 vs 1025x1025 mesh 'maps to the libEQDBMS.a vs libEQDBMS_1025.a variants and is not selectable per-record at read time' is asserted without a quoted source line, unlike the three load-bearing lines quoted at section -entry-lines, and it is not verifiable from the run's recorded output (the shared library was not disassembled and the read itself failed). Record the source line or mark it as unverified.
